turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Hi there, how are you feeling after the surgery?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Aiya, my knee still got some pain one, but not too bad lah. The block they give me help a lot.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Good to hear. Any nausea or vomiting feeling after waking up?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Slightly dizzy one, but stomach okay. Not like I want to throw up or anything.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Any trouble breathing or feeling uncomfortable with your airway?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Throat a bit sore from the tube, but breathing is fine. Can talk normally also.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Do you remember anything about the surgery itself?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Nope, all black out. Wake up already in recovery room.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: You mentioned allergic rhinitis before. Any nasal congestion or allergy symptoms now?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Nose a bit blocked, but not sneezing or watery eyes. Same as usual lah.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: We'll keep an eye on that. Overall, how are you coping?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Quite okay, doctor. Just want to go home and rest. Thank you for checking on me.
